title: Sweep stale Engram worktrees on Central whose items have closed
outcome: Sweep stale Engram worktrees on Central whose items have closed
acceptance: Every Engram worktree on Central under .worktrees/ whose item(s) are completed or cancelled and whose evidence is recorded is removed with non-forced git worktree remove by a Codex session, after the repository's cleanup checks (path inside the repo, no live process or claim, no frozen input, no unique unpushed change); worktrees still serving open work are kept and listed with their owner
The sweep records what was removed and what was kept, and why, on this item
